# Ze (Mark) Song — Portfolio

> Ze (Mark) Song is a programmer and builder in Aurora, Ontario, Canada. He works in admin, HR and IT at Newood Millwork Inc. (custom cabinetry, Concord, Ontario), founded York Region Web Studio, and created Foxuma, a business platform for cabinet and millwork shops. This site showcases his live work: 2 featured products and 21 projects hosted on GitHub Pages, including 13 free bilingual (English / Chinese) mini-apps. Contact: marksong0000@gmail.com

## Featured

- [Foxuma](https://foxuma.com): Business platform for cabinet and millwork shops — projects, orders, customers, invoicing, payroll support and a built-in office assistant (Secretary Fox). Pricing (CAD): Pro $99/month flat, unlimited seats, all features, no setup fee; first year $79/month; founding offer for the first 10 shops: $79/month locked for 2 years. 7-day free trial, no card required. Data stored in Canada.
- [York Region Web Studio](https://yorkregionwebstudio.com): Custom websites and systems for small businesses in York Region, Ontario. Priced by written quote.

## Services (on this site)

- [Windows 11 Setup Service](https://marksong0917.github.io/win11-setup/): LTSC-clean Windows 11 setup done for you, remote or on-site in the GTA. From $149 per PC.
- [Private Server Setup Service](https://marksong0917.github.io/server-setup/): Xray VLESS+REALITY and Hysteria2 server setup on your VPS or home PC. $199 setup, optional care $20/month.
- [Home Server Guide](https://marksong0917.github.io/home-server-guide/): Free guide — turn an old PC into a 24/7 private server.
- [Website Template Pack](https://marksong0917.github.io/template-pack/): York Region Web Studio template collection.
- [Foxuma Case Study](https://marksong0917.github.io/case-study/): How Foxuma runs a real cabinet shop day to day.

## Tools (mini-apps and demos)

- [Image Compressor](https://marksong0917.github.io/imgcompress/): Shrink images in the browser; nothing uploads.
- [QR Maker](https://marksong0917.github.io/qr-maker/): Create QR codes in the browser with PNG download.
- [ID Photo Maker](https://marksong0917.github.io/id-photo/): Crop photos to ID, passport and visa sizes at print resolution.
- [Size Converter](https://marksong0917.github.io/size-converter/): Inch fractions to millimetres and back, for the trades.
- [Stair Calculator](https://marksong0917.github.io/stair-calculator/): Risers, treads, run and stringer length with comfort checks.
- [Self-Measure Kit](https://marksong0917.github.io/measure-kit/): Homeowners measure a kitchen or closet; the shop gets a quote-ready summary.
- [Trade Estimator](https://marksong0917.github.io/estimator/): Instant price-range estimator a shop embeds on its website.
- [Pomodoro](https://marksong0917.github.io/pomodoro/): A 25-minute focus timer with breaks.
- [Countdown Days](https://marksong0917.github.io/countdown/): Countdown cards for important dates.

## Language learning

- [Type the Classics](https://marksong0917.github.io/typebook-zh/): Read Chinese and English classics by typing them; 18 books.
- [TypeWords](https://marksong0917.github.io/typewords/): Learn 120 English curriculum words by typing, with audio.
- [Dictation](https://marksong0917.github.io/dictation/): Listen and type — Chinese poetry, idioms and English sentences.
- [Stroke Order](https://marksong0917.github.io/stroke-order/): Animated stroke order and tracing for 96 common Chinese characters.

## Games

- [Idiom Solitaire](https://marksong0917.github.io/idiom-chain/): Chain Chinese idioms head-to-tail against the computer; 420 idioms.
- [Lucky Wheel](https://marksong0917.github.io/lucky-wheel/): Spin-the-wheel decision maker.

## More

- [Mir2 Game Server](https://marksong0917.github.io/mir2/): Self-hosted Legend of Mir 2 (1.76) server.
- [Windows 11 Optimization Guide](https://marksong0917.github.io/win11-optimization-guide/): A clean, low-bloat Windows 11 setup, step by step (English and Chinese).
- [GitHub profile](https://github.com/marksong0917): Source code for the open-source projects.

## 中文简介

> 宋泽（Mark Song）是住在加拿大安大略省奥罗拉的程序员和建造者。他在 Newood Millwork Inc.（Concord 的定制橱柜厂）做行政、人事和 IT，创办了 York Region Web Studio，并开发了 Foxuma — 一套给橱柜和木作店用的企业平台。这个网站展示他的实际作品：2 个重点产品和 21 个托管在 GitHub Pages 上的项目，包括 13 个免费的双语（英文 / 中文）小应用。联系：marksong0000@gmail.com

- Foxuma（https://foxuma.com）：给橱柜和木作店的企业平台 — 项目、订单、客户、发票、工时支持和内置办公室助手（Secretary Fox）。价格（加元）：专业版每月 99 加元一口价，不限席位、全部功能、无开办费；第一年每月 79 加元；创始优惠：前 10 家每月 79 加元，锁定 2 年。7 天免费试用，不用绑卡。数据存在加拿大。
- York Region Web Studio（https://yorkregionwebstudio.com）：为约克区小商家做定制网站和系统。书面报价定价。
- 服务：Windows 11 装机（每台 149 加元起）、私有服务器搭建（199 加元）、家庭服务器指南（免费）。
